people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded to be done.”
translations.bsb: And Moses said to them, “This is what the LORD has commanded to be done.”
translations.kjv: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which the LORD commanded to be done.
translations.asv: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which Jehovah hath commanded to be done.
